title: EasyRecipes
description: Fixes a lot of terrible recipes in Minecraft
body:
This datapack is very simple - it just fixes a bunch of recipes. The list is below:


TNT: 4 sand, 1 gunpowder = 4 TNT

![TNT Recipe Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6798afcea371082f4325e50e9e7e5c49dff19370.png)


Notch Apple: 8 gold blocks, 1 apple

![Enchanted Golden Apple Recipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6baae071d1df14699626ed4beb13bfea8e38b4e1.png)


Name Tag: 1 string, 1 paper, 1 iron ingot

![Name Tag Recipe Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/35c8c976ad489223b4ad86d730f289d913371eee.png)


Saddle: 4 leather, 1 iron ingot

![Saddle Recipe Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4615ddcca56eb1bafb3b434539c30950eca0278b.png)


Slime Block: 1 honey block, 1 green dye

![Slime Block Recipe Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37122005e642a358128042c6cd34988e5d1207e8.png)


Totem of Undying: 4 blocks of gold, 4 emerald blocks, and 1 enchanted golden apple.

![Totem of Undying Recipe Image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ea24cd86efddd0e6f23f5137e2d91caf3c410ef.png)
